notes.title: Soundtrack and developer support bundle release
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing the official soundtrack of Magic Thief! It includes both 8 songs that sounded in the game, as well as music from the trailer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1923300/Magic_Thief_Soundtrack/

Music created to emphasize the atmosphere of the magical Middle Ages of the world of Magic Thief. Sometimes mysterious, bewitching music and melodic string picking are complemented by the instruments of a classical symphony orchestra.

After purchase, you will have access to two catalogs: MP3 and WAV (high quality audio).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41129995/5e2e042a6e7e7d28faf04575bff7f982cdfbf50a.jpg

Track list:
[olist] Main Theme - 1:16
 Map Theme - 0:25
 Tutorial Theme - 1:57
 Taverns Theme - 5:20
 Dungeons Theme - 4:54
 Goblin Caves Theme - 5:03
 Kings Crypts Theme - 5:19
 The Void Theme - 5:07
 Trailer Theme - 0:59[/olist]

Along with the soundtrack, we're adding a bundle of game and soundtrack to the sale, made for players who want to support us.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25097/Magic_Thief__Soundtrack/

The soundtrack will later be added to all popular music streaming platforms.

notes.title: Beta Update v1.1
notes.notes:
Patch notes to the version Beta v1.1 of the game

Improvements:
- Optimization of the space occupied by the game on the disk drive from 3.81 GB to 1.72 GB
- Reduced RAM consumption
- Accelerated loadings
- In the low preset of the graphics settings, the quality of detail is further simplified
- Updating the environment of the first location

Bug fixes:
- Fixed a bug that caused a window to appear for the first time when starting a new game notifying that the saved data will be deleted.
- Fixed errors of the user interface in "Tutorial" on ultra-wide screens
- Fixed errors in Russian localization
